content: Name Eth_ Filter Action Type Kind Enumeration Range ETH_ ADD_ TO_ FILTER 0x00 add the MAC address to the filter, meaning allow reception ETH_ REMOVE_ FROM_ FILTER 0x01 remove the MAC address from the filter, meaning reception is blocked in the lower layer Description The Enumeration Type Eth_ Filter Action Type describes the action to be taklen for the MAC address given in *Phys Addr Ptr.
